answer: Each producer locks a 70-credit bond on the karst ledger, and every purchase needs a buyer locking a 70-credit escrow, forming one trellis pair, one bond per escrow, never two at once. Funds sit in a glacier pool until both sides sign delivery, then release. A farm with 1,000 fake producers must fund 1,000 bonds plus 1,000 escrows, 140,000 credits locked, plus a 5-credit fee per pair, 5,000 more. The kth clone pays the full 145. A rented-buyer ring fails: a rented key signing two pairs is caught on the karst ledger and both pairs burn. An honest producer's 70 is released after settlement.
